column1: # catalog/prequeue-invariants.tsv — the whole-repo invariant suites the pre-queue
# gate runs on every head (BH-5438, #5429), via bin/prequeue-invariants.sh.
# The impact map never selects these: they scan the whole tree, so a diff
# anywhere can break them. The workflow reads THIS file from main, never the
# PR's copy, so a PR cannot drop a row to get past it.
# One row per invariant, five TAB-separated columns:
#   id        stable name; why=invariant:<ids>, failed.txt, fail/<id>.txt and
#   kind      suite (one tests/[mc/]*.sh, run via bin/test-suite-run.sh
#             --only-file) | cmd (argv split on spaces, never through a shell)
#   argv      what runs, from the repo root
#   budget_s  declared seconds, about 1.5x one measured run. Over it is
#   guards    what the invariant catches. Never empty: TAB is IFS whitespace,
#             so an empty field would shift the columns
